tools.name: status
tools.description: Report whether an APK is loaded and basic info (path, class count, resource count, load duration).

tools.name: load_apk

path.description: Absolute path to the APK / DEX / JAR.

include_packages.description: Comma-separated package/FQN prefixes to KEEP (e.g. com.gcash,com.mynt). Overrides CLI --include-packages for this load.

exclude_packages.description: Comma-separated package prefixes to DROP (e.g. androidx,kotlin). Overrides CLI --exclude-packages for this load.

threads.description: jadx pre-decompile workers. 0 = all cores. Omit to keep the server default (min(CPU,4)).

code_cache_size.description: Max decompiled top-level classes kept in RAM (LRU). 0 = unlimited. Omit to keep the server default (64).

resources.description: full | lite | none. lite keeps Manifest+strings+arsc; none hides non-manifest resources. jadx 1.5.6 still parses arsc at load.

tools.description: Load an APK / DEX / JAR. Replaces any currently-loaded file. Blocks until indexing completes (typically a few seconds to a minute depending on size). Optional include_packages/exclude_packages, threads, code_cache_size, resources (full|lite|none) override the server CLI defaults for this load.

tools.name: unload_apk
tools.description: Release the currently-loaded APK and free memory. No-op if nothing is loaded.

tools.name: get_app_info
tools.description: Return package name, version, minSdk/targetSdk, and permissions parsed from AndroidManifest.xml.

tools.name: get_android_manifest

section.description: One of: permissions, activities, services, providers, receivers, application. Omit for full manifest.

tools.description: Return decoded AndroidManifest.xml. Use section=permissions|activities|services|providers|receivers|application to slice (much cheaper than the full manifest, which can be 50KB+). max_bytes truncates the result.

tools.name: get_main_activity_class
tools.description: Return the FQN of the LAUNCHER activity (action MAIN + category LAUNCHER).

tools.name: list_classes

prefix.description: Optional FQN prefix, e.g. 'com.applovin'. Matches both equal and dot-suffix.

tools.description: Paginated list of class FQNs. Optional prefix narrows to a package subtree (e.g. 'com.applovin').

tools.name: get_main_application_classes_names
tools.description: Return FQNs of classes whose package matches the AndroidManifest 'package' attribute. Useful as a lightweight 'is the right APK loaded' probe.

tools.name: get_class_source

class_name.description: Fully-qualified class name, e.g. com.example.Foo. Inner/Companion forms (Outer$Inner, Outer.Companion) are accepted.

max_bytes.description: Per-call truncation AFTER decompile; does not speed up jadx. Prefer smaller fetches via get_method_by_name.

smali_fallback.description: Auto-fall back to smali when Java decompilation fails (default true). Set false to force the partial Java.

tools.description: Return decompiled Java source. If jadx hits anti-decompile stubs (goto obfuscation, 'Code decompiled incorrectly' / 'Method not decompiled' banners), it transparently returns the class SMALI instead, prefixed with '// [jadx java-decompile failed → smali]' (disable with smali_fallback=false). Accepts inner/$Companion names. Truncated at max_bytes AFTER jadx finishes; hard-aborts after decompile_timeout_ms (default 90s). Prefer get_class_summary + get_method_by_name/get_method_body for large classes.

tools.name: get_class_summary
tools.description: Lightweight class skeleton: method signatures, field names, inner class names — no method bodies. Cheaper than get_class_source for navigation; use it to pick which method to drill into.

tools.name: get_smali_of_class

offset.description: Byte offset into the full class smali to start from (for paging). Default 0.

tools.description: Return smali (DEX disassembly). Smali is often 2-3x source size, so large classes truncate. To page a huge class pass offset (byte offset into the full smali) with max_bytes as the window size; the response header reports total_bytes and next_offset. For a single method prefer get_method_smali. Hard-aborts after decompile_timeout_ms (default 90s). Accepts inner/$Companion names.

tools.name: get_fields_of_class
tools.description: List fields of a class. Paginated; use filter to narrow by name (case-insensitive substring); names_only=true for a compact name list.

tools.name: get_inner_classes
tools.description: List the inner/nested classes of a class, each with its dotted full_name AND raw_name (the $-joined runtime form, e.g. Outer$Companion) so you can address them directly. Resolves $Companion / inner / fuzzy names.

tools.name: resolve_class
tools.description: Resolve a possibly-inaccurate class name (inner/$Companion/dotted/fuzzy) to its exact FQN, or list candidate FQNs when ambiguous. Use this when get_class_source says 'class not found'. Metadata-only (no decompile).

tools.name: get_methods_of_class
tools.description: List methods of a class. Paginated; use filter to narrow by name (case-insensitive substring); names_only=true for a compact name list.

tools.name: get_method_by_name

smali_fallback.description: Fall back to method smali when Java decompile fails (default true).

tools.description: Return the decompiled Java source of a single method. If overloaded, returns the first match. If jadx fails to decompile the body (anti-decompile stub), transparently returns that method's SMALI with a '// [jadx java-decompile failed → smali]' marker (disable via smali_fallback=false). Accepts inner/$Companion class names.

tools.name: get_method_body

overload_index.description: 0-based index when the name is overloaded (default 0).

smali_fallback.description: Fall back to method smali when Java decompile fails (default true).

tools.description: Return ONE method as Java if it decompiles, else its SMALI — with a JSON envelope reporting which. The method-level counterpart of get_class_source's smali fallback; use it to read a single method out of a huge/obfuscated class without dumping the whole class. Reports mode ('java'|'smali'), fell_back, and any decompile-failure markers. Accepts inner/$Companion class names and overloaded methods (set overload_index).

tools.name: get_method_smali
tools.description: Return the SMALI of a single method (all overloads of the name), sliced out of the class disassembly. Cheap way to read one method from a huge class instead of get_smali_of_class. Accepts inner/$Companion class names.

tools.name: search_method_by_name
tools.description: Search for methods by name across all classes. Exact match preferred, falls back to substring.

tools.name: search_classes_by_keyword

package.description: Optional FQN prefix filter, e.g. 'com.applovin'. Strongly recommended with 'code' scope.

max_scan.description: Cap on classes scanned. 0 = use defaults (all classes for metadata; 20000 with package + code; 5000 without package + code). Overridable server-wide via --max-scan.

tools.description: Search classes across one or more scopes: 'class' (FQN), 'method', 'field' names (all cheap, metadata-only), and 'code' (decompiled source body — expensive: decompiles each scanned class). Always pass 'package' when using 'code' scope on large APKs, otherwise the scan cap will cut you off. Accepts comma-separated 'search_in' (default 'class'). Returns hits with which scope matched and a code snippet when 'code' matches.

tools.name: get_xrefs_to_class

resolve_line.description: Resolve each usage's source line (force-decompiles its class). Default false; set true only when you need line numbers.

tools.description: List code sites that reference the given class.

tools.name: get_xrefs_to_method

resolve_line.description: Resolve each usage's source line (force-decompiles its class). Default false; set true only when you need line numbers.

tools.description: List code sites that call the given method.

tools.name: get_xrefs_to_field

resolve_line.description: Resolve each usage's source line (force-decompiles its class). Default false; set true only when you need line numbers.

tools.description: List code sites that reference the given field.

tools.name: get_strings

filter.description: case-insensitive substring filter on string value or name

tools.description: Return string resources from res/values/strings*.xml. Optionally filter by substring.

tools.name: list_resource_files

filter.description: case-insensitive substring filter on file name

tools.description: List names of resource files in the APK. With resources=lite this is Manifest + strings XML + arsc; with resources=none only AndroidManifest.xml.

tools.name: get_resource_file

name.description: Resource file name as reported by list_resource_files

tools.description: Return the content of a resource file (text decoded if possible, otherwise base64).
